name: Continuous Level Transitions
definition: A procedure to ensure continuity of the 3D scalar field at level transitions by adapting brick textures on the finer level to interpolate from the coarser level, restricting transitions to differ by at most one level.
summary: Continuous Level Transitions adapts finer brick textures to ensure scalar field continuity with coarser neighbors, distinguished by restricting transitions to a maximum one-level difference.
